description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) my question is about the keeping of the Holy Day Sabbath whereby the verse itself says  Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy. 9 Six days you shall labor and do all your work, 10 but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your male or female servant, nor your animals, nor any foreigner residing in your towns. 11 For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy. Due to the mode of payments we have in these last days (Technology) does it make sense to refrain from buying anything on the Holy Day except buying Electricity units or mobile phones units on the Sabbath?
.
2.) "as an Adventist I have known from my youth days that 27 AD is the year Jesus was baptised.  This is based on Luke 3 which says that during the 15 year of Tiberius Ceasar, Jesus was baptised.  However, when I went to the internet to Tiberius started ruling from 14 AD.  If you add 15 years to 14 AD, we arrive at 29 AD.
Is there something wrong here?"
.
3.) "In the book Patriarchs and Prophets, p.36 § 5 EGW says :""Christ was
still to exercise divine power, in the creation of the earth and its
inhabitants."" In 1 John 1 : 5 the Bible declares : ""This is the
message we have heard from him and declare to you : God is light ; in
him there is no darkness at all. So : could ""darkness"" mentioned in
Genesis 1 : 2 "" an indication of the creation (or organization) of the
earth after Satan's rebellion in heaven found in Revelation 12 : 7 -
9. I am looking a biblical verse attesting the creation of the earth
after Satan's rebellion in heaven. Thankfully. pr Frédy from French
Polynesia."
.
4.) Why are our churches changing  into worship center and preaching the prosperity messages.  Is this according to any of our message?
.
.
